title: Apple Reveals New iPad Mini with OLED Screen and A20 Pro Chip
excerpt: Apple has announced an updated iPad mini featuring a thinner design, a bright OLED display, and a faster A20 Pro processor.
body_html:
Apple has announced a newly updated version of the iPad mini. The refreshed device comes equipped with an OLED display and a faster A20 Pro chip.

According to the company, the latest model features a lighter and thinner design compared to the previous generation.
